title: Connected TV and Over-The-Top Advertising Solutions in Tampa - Advertise In Tampa

facts.fact: The vendor, Beasley Media Group (Advertise In Tampa), states it has over 60 years of experience connecting businesses to engaged audiences.
facts.quote: We're a content and marketing powerhouse with over 60 years of experience connecting businesses to engaged audiences.

facts.fact: The vendor claims an audience of 1,499,200 Tampa Bay consumers available for targeting.
facts.quote: Tap into our growing audience of 1,499,200 Tampa Bay consumers eager to learn about your business.

facts.fact: The vendor offers CTV/OTT ad format options including preroll, midroll and postroll placements.
facts.quote: Engage with your audience by choosing from a range of ad format options, including preroll, midroll and postroll

facts.fact: The vendor states CTV audiences can be selected by addresses, consumer behaviors, and demographics.
facts.quote: Simply choose who you want to see your ads by selecting the addresses, consumer behaviors, and demographics that align with your brand.
